Description: Governed Amazon Athena analytics layer for ZIPCO Relational Dataset v2.

KmsKeyArn.Description: Optional ZIPCO customer-managed KMS key ARN. Empty preserves the SSE-S3 baseline.

DatabaseInput.Name: zipco_financial_analytics
DatabaseInput.Description: Reusable Athena views over the governed ZIPCO v2 curated tables.

Properties.Name: zipco-risk-analytics
Properties.Description: Governed Athena SQL workgroup for ZIPCO risk analytics and validation.

Properties.Name: ZIPCO 01 - Executive transaction snapshot
Properties.Description: Portfolio transaction volume, value, reach, and active date range.
Properties.QueryString: SELECT count(*) AS transaction_count, round(sum(amount), 2) AS transaction_value, round(avg(amount), 2) AS average_transaction, count(DISTINCT accountid) AS active_accounts, count(DISTINCT customerid) AS active_customers, min(transactiondate) AS first_transaction_date, max(transactiondate) AS last_transaction_date FROM v_transaction_enriched

Properties.Name: ZIPCO 02 - Risk profile by transaction category
Properties.Description: Transaction totals and high-value concentration by type and category.
Properties.QueryString: SELECT transactiontype, categoryname, count(*) AS transaction_count, round(sum(amount), 2) AS transaction_value, round(avg(amount), 2) AS average_amount, count_if(amount >= DECIMAL '9000.00') AS high_value_count, round(100.0 * count_if(amount >= DECIMAL '9000.00') / count(*), 2) AS high_value_pct FROM v_transaction_enriched GROUP BY transactiontype, categoryname ORDER BY transaction_value DESC

Properties.Name: ZIPCO 03 - Highest customer exposure
Properties.Description: Customers with the largest balance and transaction exposure.
Properties.QueryString: SELECT customerid, customername, account_count, total_balance, transaction_count, transaction_value, high_value_transaction_count, first_transaction_date, last_transaction_date FROM v_customer_portfolio ORDER BY transaction_value DESC, total_balance DESC LIMIT 25

Properties.Name: ZIPCO 04 - Annual activity trend
Properties.Description: Annual transaction values, active customers, and high-value activity.
Properties.QueryString: SELECT transaction_year, sum(transaction_count) AS transaction_count, round(sum(transaction_value), 2) AS transaction_value, max(active_customers) AS peak_monthly_active_customers, sum(high_value_count) AS high_value_count FROM v_monthly_risk_metrics GROUP BY transaction_year ORDER BY transaction_year
